avis.titre: Gentle, effective, and perfect for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've been using the Detox Facial Pads (Gentle 60ct) consistently, and they've become a reliable part of my routine. They're truly gentle — no burning, no redness, and no tight feeling afterward. The formula removes leftover sunscreen and daily buildup without stripping my skin barrier, which is important for anyone with sensitive or combination skin. I also appreciate that the pads stay saturated and don't dry out in the container. My skin feels clean, smooth, and balanced after each use. If you want something that supports your skin without overwhelming it, these are a great choice.
